title: Topic model, state machine and submission
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/lib/topics/state-machine.ts (pure): canTransition(from, to, actor) for draft->submitted (team), submitted->under_review (supervisor), under_review->approved|rejected|revision_requested (supervisor), revision_requested|rejected->submitted (team). Exhaustive unit tests including every illegal pair.
src/lib/matching/jaccard.ts: normaliseTags and tagOverlap only (capacity and match score are added in 06-01). Unit tests.
models/topic (schema, repo). Input fields: title, abstract, problem_statement, proposed_solution, tech_stack[] (lowercased, trimmed, deduplicated, max 12), preference_rank 1|2|3.

src/app/actions/submit-topic.ts: create draft, edit draft, submit, resubmit. Rules: caller is a member of the team; any member may draft, only the leader may submit; team must have >= 4 members; max 3 current topics per team with unique preference_rank among is_current; first submission sets team.status topic_pending. Resubmit runs in a transaction: copy the current doc to topics/{id}/history/{version}, version += 1, status submitted, is_current stays true.

src/lib/topics/similar.ts + findSimilarTopics(): token Jaccard on title + tech_stack against approved topics from earlier academic years (limit 300). submit-topic returns warnings [{topic_id, title, score}] when score >= 0.6 and never blocks submission.
Tests: state machine, rank uniqueness, versioning writes history, non-leader submit rejected, < 4 members rejected, similarity threshold.
assumptions: Any member can draft; only the leader submits (spec is silent)
Teams need at least 4 members to submit topics
acceptance: All unit and server tests pass
